note: Decision 88: the door runs on the labels (the labels file, data/labels.json). One question, its kinds, then "anything". A film sits under every kind it is labelled with, at most two; a film not yet labelled waits behind the door under "anything" and "Just pick one!" only. A kind under 30 films in the library is not offered.
